title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover the best free social spaces and activities at Bentley University, from high-tech learning labs to quiet campus greens.

cards.title: Relax in the Living Room
cards.subtitle: Bentley Student Center
cards.notes: Visit the first floor for pool and ping pong tables. You can rent equipment for free at the third-floor Business Center with your student ID.
cards.short_summary: A central social hub with free games and lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Living Room contains pool and ping pong tables, with free equipment rentals from the Business Center.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during Student Center hours; equipment requires Bentley ID.

cards.title: Browse the RSM Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library
cards.notes: Located at the library entrance, this gallery features six rotating exhibits annually by New England artists and is open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A free public art space located within the main university library.
cards.evidence_claim: The RSM Art Gallery is free and open to the public when the library is open.
cards.source_title: RSM Art Gallery at the Bentley Library
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; accessible to the general public.

cards.title: Ride the Harvard Shuttle
cards.subtitle: Campus Transportation
cards.notes: Board the shuttle at the Student Center for a free ride to Harvard Square. Remember to bring your Bentley ID for boarding.
cards.short_summary: Free transportation for students between campus and Cambridge.
cards.evidence_claim: All Bentley Shuttles are free. You must show a Bentley ID when boarding.
cards.source_title: Shuttle Routes and Schedules - Bentley University
cards.access_notes: Requires valid Bentley ID; runs daily with reduced weekend hours.

cards.title: Workout at the Dana Center
cards.subtitle: Lower Campus
cards.notes: Access two floors of cardio and endurance equipment. The 10,000-square-foot fitness room is open to all current students.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus fitness facility for student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dana Center Gym is available to students, staff, and faculty and features a 10,000-square foot fitness/weight room.
cards.access_notes: Bentley ID card required for entry.

cards.title: Study in a Library Pod
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library
cards.notes: Choose from individual study carrels, cozy pods, or collaborative zones. Group rooms can be reserved for free via the EMS system.
cards.short_summary: Diverse quiet and collaborative study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Bentley Library offers a variety of study spaces including individual study carrels, cozy study pods, and 22 collaborative study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Open to students; some zones are designated for silent study.

cards.title: Explore the Trading Room
cards.subtitle: Smith Academic Technology Center
cards.notes: Visit this high-tech lab to use Bloomberg terminals and real-time financial data. It is open for student research outside of class times.
cards.short_summary: A world-class financial lab with professional-grade tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trading Room features 60 workstations and 24 Bloomberg terminals available for student use.
cards.source_title: Trading Room (Hughey Center for Financial Services)
cards.access_notes: Available to students when not in use for scheduled classes.

cards.title: Hang Out on the Green
cards.subtitle: Upper Campus
cards.notes: This central lawn is the primary spot for outdoor socializing, sunbathing, and campus-wide events like Earthfest.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor gathering spot on the upper campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Campus Green Space is a designated outdoor space used for events and student gatherings.

cards.entity_name: Center for Languages and International Collaboration (CLIC)
cards.title: Visit the CLIC Lab
cards.subtitle: Adamian Academic Center
cards.notes: Use this multipurpose space for language practice and cultural exchange. It offers specialized software and a collaborative atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative space for language learning and international culture.
cards.evidence_claim: CLIC is a multipurpose collaborative space that fosters communication across languages and cultures.
cards.source_title: Learning Labs: Where Learning Meets Technology | Bentley University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during lab hours.

cards.title: Tune Your Bike for Free
cards.subtitle: Campus Amenities
cards.notes: Use the Dero Fix-it station to perform basic repairs. It includes tools and an air pump for public use near the campus bike racks.
cards.short_summary: A self-service station for free bicycle maintenance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dero Bike Fix-it station includes all tools necessary for basic repairs and is available for the community.

cards.title: Find Quiet in the Sacred Space
cards.subtitle: Student Center
cards.notes: Located on the lower level, this room is available for prayer, meditation, or quiet reflection away from the busy campus life.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet room for spiritual and personal reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sacred Space in the Student Center provides a quiet space for prayer and reflection.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during Student Center hours.
